name: POST /api/leadflow/segments/preview - eligibility with every refusal named
description:
Estimates an audience over the GOVERNED dimensions and returns every refusal with its reason (73357dd8-628f-47fa-9e41-1b42cf1f23fc#AC2). The breakdown is the deliverable, not the count: "412 eligible" tells a marketer nothing they can act on, while naming that 60 have no consent, 21 are suppressed and 7 are licensed records whose rights forbid this channel tells them which of those they can fix and which they must never try to.

SOURCE RIGHTS ARE CHECKED FIRST AND SEPARATELY (73357dd8-628f-47fa-9e41-1b42cf1f23fc#AC1). It is the one check that is contractual rather than operational - consent can be re-obtained and a suppression can expire, but a licence that forbids marketing SMS forbids it permanently. A record that fails here never reaches the channel decision at all, not even to be denied there, because a denial is still a decision about a record we should not be considering.

THE PURPOSE-TO-PERMITTED-USE MAP IS EXPLICIT, never a substring match. "marketing" in a purpose key and "Marketing SMS" in a licence are different vocabularies, and matching them loosely is exactly how a record licensed for Marketing Email enters an SMS audience.

AN UNREACHABLE RIGHTS SERVICE EXCLUDES RATHER THAN ADMITS, under its own reason code so an outage is distinguishable from a genuine restriction. Unknown rights are not permissive rights, and "the service was down" is not a defence anybody accepts after a contractual breach.

Budget exhaustion in the bulk eligibility pass is also NAMED rather than treated as eligible - a caller that believes it holds a verdict it never got would send to it. QA: measured live; both a first-party and a licensed candidate were correctly held out with different reasons.

testCases.name: The estimate breaks down eligible versus excluded with a reason on each refusal
NEGATIVE: no purpose_key, so source rights cannot be checked at all
NEGATIVE: no Authorization header at all
NEGATIVE: a bearer token that does not verify

errorCases.message: purpose_key and channel are both required - eligibility is a property of the pair, and a segment with no stated purpose cannot be checked against source rights at all
errorCases.when: purpose_key or channel is missing, or candidates is empty.

errorCases.message: Authorization header with a bearer token is required
errorCases.when: the Authorization header is absent, empty, or uses a scheme other than Bearer.

errorCases.message: Session token is invalid or expired
errorCases.when: a Bearer token was presented but does not verify.
